title: The Place Holding Supplement on a Snowsports School Booking
content:
A place already held for a block of sessions carries a place holding supplement on a Snowsports School booking, judged from the block loaded against the booking.

Where the block loaded holds three or more sessions, the long block supplement of 40.00 USD is added. Where the block loaded holds one or two sessions, the short block supplement of 20.00 USD is added. Where no block has been loaded against the booking, no place holding supplement is added, the supplement standing at 0.00 USD.

## Schedule of supplements

| Sessions the block loaded against the booking holds | Supplement added |
| --- | --- |
| 3 or more | 40.00 USD |
| exactly 3 | 40.00 USD |
| 2 | 20.00 USD |
| 1 | 20.00 USD |
| no block loaded at all | 0.00 USD |

What is read is the block loaded against that booking, as the loading entries on its school account show it, and not the number of sessions the product is sold with. A booking on which no block has yet been loaded falls in the last band whatever product it is for.

## Worked readings

- A booking whose loaded block holds 6 sessions carries a supplement of 40.00 USD.
- A booking whose loaded block holds 2 sessions carries a supplement of 20.00 USD.
- A booking of a product sold as a block of 5 sessions, on which no block has yet been loaded, carries no supplement at all.
